weekend.howCourtBody: Think the feed called a player's position wrong? File a claim — you get 2 filings per gameweek, and filing counts as the first endorsement. A claim that gathers enough endorsements (at least 15, or 0.5% of the gameweek's actives) goes to trial; a trial passes on a 60% share with quorum (at least 30, or 1%). Filing closes Monday 23:59; verdicts land Tuesday evening and re-score the player before scores go final.
weekend.howCrewBody: 2–8 friends, share-code to join, snake draft where every player can be owned once per room. Each drafter gets a chess-clock bank of 30 seconds per round — 390s spent freely across all 13 picks; an empty bank auto-picks the rest.
weekend.howCrowdBody: head-to-head crowd votes on real performances move a player's score by up to ±15%. Performances with too few votes keep their base score.
weekend.howDefendingBody: clean sheets pay GK +5 / DEF +4 / MID +1 (60+ minutes); GKs and DEFs lose 1 point per 2 goals conceded. Tackles, interceptions, blocks, saves, key passes and dribbles all score small amounts, each capped so volume can't be farmed. Sustained excellence pays via ramps: defenders' duel dominance and midfielders' pass completion each earn up to +2.
weekend.howDuplicatesBody: a squad is 13 players, not 13 slots.
weekend.howFinalityBody: scores go final at 23:59 (Paris time) the day after the window closes.
weekend.howFinishersBody: score only from their entry minute onward, and their goals and assists after the 75th minute are multiplied ×1.25 — the decisive-moment multiplier.
weekend.howGoalsBody: goals pay +5 to +8 and assists +3 to +6 — the deeper the position, the more they pay (a GK goal is +8, a striker's +5).
weekend.howLocksBody: Each player locks individually at his own kickoff. Until then swap, re-slot and reshuffle freely; after it, that slot is frozen and the cost committed. A player whose match has already kicked off can't be swapped IN — no hindsight picks. Editing Sunday around a locked Saturday is the intended skill.
weekend.howShapeBody: exactly 1 GK, 3–5 DEF, 2–5 MID, 1–3 ATT in the XI. Finishers carry their own position, chosen freely.
weekend.howTableBody: ranked by cumulative points; equal points are broken by head-to-head weekend wins; still level is a displayed tie.
weekend.howTeamBody: +1 for a win, +0.5 for a draw, if the player played 60+ minutes.
weekend.howTemplatesBody: a player scores through the template of the slot YOU fielded him in. If the match verdict says he actually played a different position, a positive score is dampened ×0.75 — mis-slotting never outscores honest slotting.
weekend.howThirteenBody: an XI plus 2 finishers (your bench with intent).
weekend.howWeekendBody: One squad for the whole European football weekend. Eight leagues, every fixture in the window counts, and the board resets fresh for each gameweek — weekend windows run Friday through Monday, midweek windows Tuesday through Thursday. No season-long grind.

default.title: Football Trivia & Quiz Games — Play Free | VerveQ
default.description: Free football quiz games: a daily quiz, guess the footballer by career path, a football grid, higher or lower and 1v1 duels. No sign-up needed.

compete.title: Play Football Quiz Games — Ranked & Casual | VerveQ
compete.description: Every VerveQ football game in one place: ranked quiz and survival, daily quizzes, duels and arena rooms with friends. Free, no download.

daily.title: Daily Quiz — Today's 10 Football Questions | VerveQ
daily.description: Today's ten football questions, the same for every player worldwide. One attempt, speed scoring, and a streak to protect. Resets at midnight UTC.

dailySurvival.title: Daily Survival — One Shared Run | VerveQ
dailySurvival.description: One shared survival run per day: name players from their initials until you run out of lives. Same run for everyone, one attempt.

whosOlder.title: Who's Older? — Daily Football Age Game | VerveQ
whosOlder.description: Two footballers, tap the older one. Ten rounds a day, and the gap shrinks from years to days. Same pairs for everyone, then play endless.

missingLetters.title: Missing Letters — Daily Guess the Footballer Game | VerveQ
missingLetters.description: Name the footballer from the missing letters. Ten names a day, easy to impossible, with a nation clue. Same names for everyone, then play endless.

blitz.title: Blitz — 60-Second Football Quiz | VerveQ
blitz.description: Sixty seconds, as many football questions as you can answer. No lifelines, no second chances — just how fast you can think. Free to play.

higherLower.title: Higher or Lower — Football Stats Game | VerveQ
higherLower.description: Is the next player's stat higher or lower? Goals, appearances and trophies, one call at a time. One wrong answer ends the streak.

careerPath.title: Career Path — Name the Player From His Clubs | VerveQ
careerPath.description: Read a footballer's club history in order and name him before you run out of guesses. Typo-friendly, hundreds of careers, no sign-up.

verveGrid.title: VerveGrid — Daily Football Grid | VerveQ
verveGrid.description: Nine cells, nine guesses. Name a player who fits both the row and the column — club, country or position. No player twice.

arena.title: Arena — Live Quiz Rooms With Friends | VerveQ
arena.description: Create a room, share the code, and everyone answers the same football questions at the same time. Live scoring, up to a full group.

duels.title: Duels — Head-to-Head Football Trivia | VerveQ
duels.description: Send a link, both of you answer the same football questions, and settle it. Your opponent doesn't need an account to play.

ranks.title: Ranks — Ratings & Top Players | VerveQ
ranks.description: Where you stand in VerveQ football trivia: global ratings, the top players in each ranked mode and who is just ahead of you.

weekendTable.title: The Weekend — Live Table | VerveQ
weekendTable.description: Live global standings for The Weekend fantasy game: provisional budget-squad points update as each fixture is scored.
